scientific_integrity: The proof is symbolic for all nonzero even \(p\) and even \(m>2\): it proves an exact \(2\)-adic valuation lemma, reduces the odd part through a shifted-unit relation, proves the odd-part period is even when needed, and recombines coprime moduli by the Chinese remainder theorem. The finite verifier is regression evidence only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem settles only the \(q=-1\) even-even period-equality question and retains the hypothesis that \(e_V(m)\) exists. It does not treat the distinct \(q=1\) question or classify entry-point existence.
title: Even-even period equality for Lucas pairs with \(q=-1\)
